description: This file defines the InstanceAPI class, a REST API controller handling installation instance data such as organization name, country code, language code, and timezone. It provides methods for handling POST requests to store data and GET requests to retrieve stored data, relying on other utility classes for validation and storage.

classes.name: InstanceAPI
classes.description: API controller for managing installation instance information, extending AbstractInstallerRestController and providing endpoints for creating and retrieving instance data.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests to store installation instance data such as organization name, country code, language code, and timezone, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Processes GET requests to retrieve stored installation instance data, including resolving codes to full objects using helper methods.
